description: AirTrafficSim: An open-source web-based air traffic simulation platform is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ka Yiu Hui, Chris HC. Nguyen (Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, The Hong Kong University of Science and 5 Technology, Hong). AirTrafficSim is a web-based air traffic simulation software written in Python and javascript. It is designed to visualize historical and simulated flight data and perform microscopic studies of air traffic movement with the integration of a historical weather database. It aims to assist users to evaluate the performance of ATM algorithms. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
